description: This Java source file defines a Spring configuration class that provides bean definitions for loan transferability services within the 'fineract-investor' module, specifically for loan account owner transfer functionality.

classes.name: LoanAccountOwnerTransferConfiguration
classes.description: A Spring configuration class that defines beans related to loan account owner transfer, particularly the LoanTransferabilityService bean.

methods.name: loanTransferabilityService
methods.description: Defines and provides the LoanTransferabilityService bean, which is instantiated as LoanTransferabilityServiceImpl using DelayedSettlementAttributeService, when no other bean of LoanTransferabilityService is present.
